prompt: PropertiesEditor.update rewrites the whole file through java.util.Properties, losing comments and order and adding a timestamp. Change only the active target key=value line while preserving all other text and line order. If the key is absent, append it using the existing newline style and leave exactly one final newline.

graders.name: fail_to_pass
graders.cmd: javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out src/*.java verify/FailToPass.java && java -cp out FailToPass
